description: FREE, no payment. GET /v1/verdicts/:id: the stored signed verdict issued by predge_verdict, byte-identical in content. The tool re-checks the ed25519 signature and returns `{ verification, record }`. 404 verdict_not_found for an unknown id. Param: id (vrd_ + 24 characters).
name: predge_get_verdict
title: Read a signed delivery verdict by id (free)
